tool_args.rationale: The five paid rows show an almost exact linear dependence on u_now (slope about 1.87), with no material variation attributable to x_now or the small horizon changes. This is sufficient for the target horizon and tolerance; no available probe has expected value over fitting and confirming the simple law.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five observations span a wide u_now range at horizons close to the requested forecast horizon; a static linear fit is already strongly constrained and buys little likely accuracy.
Auxiliary high-variance measurements do not resolve the relevant response law and are explicitly unnecessary.

At the observed and target horizons its predictions are already nearly indistinguishable from a static linear response; estimating a weak transient adds complexity without material benefit at the stated tolerance.
These depend on u_now nonlinearly and/or H, while the observed outputs track a single linear u_now response across varied x_now and horizon.
